title: Living world objects (data/livingworld/objects.yaml)
description: What the living-world items do on the map (livingworld/README.md, docs/06 "Mundo vivo"): each entry names an item of data/items and exactly one behaviour. make validate also refuses walls, doors and grounds here, a breakable or pushable item that does not block movement, debris or an open gate that blocks it, an item with two entries and sounds missing from assets/sounds.yaml; the map validator refuses these objects on protection zones, houses and door tiles. The server applies the same rules at start (livingworld/server Resolve).

hp.description: Hit points. A melee strike or a shot takes the weapon's attack (5 bare-handed), a tool the tool's damage, fire the spell's damage.

by.description: Ways it breaks: melee (a strike from a tile next to it), any_attack (melee, or a distance weapon or wand within range), tool:axe (an axe: a woodcutting tool or a weapon of type axe), tool:pick (a mining tool), fire (a fire area spell or rune over its tile, or a fire wand).

becomes.description: Item of its debris (must not block movement), or none: nothing is left.

debris_seconds.description: How long the debris lies before it fades (default 20). At most respawn_seconds.

respawn_seconds.description: How long after it broke it stands again (default 300), once no creature nor loose item is on its tile.

loot.description: Rolled once per break like a monster's loot; the items land on its tile.

reset_seconds.description: That long after its last push it goes back where the map put it, once that tile is free (0 or absent: never).

open.description: Item of the open gate (must not block movement). It opens while every plate within a plate's radius is pressed, and closes when one is not, once nothing stands in it.

radius.description: The plate is linked to every gate within this many tiles (Chebyshev) on its floor. A creature or a pushable object on it presses it.

effect.description: Material of the hit and break particles (livingworld/client).
